The comment is applied for the others log in this patch set also.
Done

Can we add on API in libresponder/Fru to allow the caller set the hostEID instead of append the Class construction?
As this code https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/pldm/+/78490/1/libpldmresponder/bios.hpp
Done
The anti-pattern is `rc = {RC}`. You can check others code in platform-mc.
Acknowledged
Can we use new instead of `reinterpret_cast`?

no @thu@os.amperecomputing.com, Using placement new with a const type (i.e., trying to construct an object into a const memory location) is usually problematic and generally not allowed, because placement new implies that you're about to write to the specified memory address, which contradicts the idea of const.

Repository change event is part of Platform Spec(https://www.dmtf.org/sites/default/files/standards/documents/DSP0248_1.2.0.pdf).
Can we move it to platform.cpp?
